title: Thresholds on the refitted traffic head's beliefs, in round 33's learned net2 and round 29's rules, validation links
description: Before the test links, the tuning rule: search what matters on validation. With the refitted head (exp-traffic-head-v7-agg-306), round 33's net2 at iteration 59 (net2-r33hn: it reads the head and takes its belief in copies q from it) and round 29's net2 with both beliefs from the head (net2-v7hpn: its actor is unused, so it is the gate3 rules switched by net1's head) passed at thresholds 0.5 (exp-traffic-head-agg-val-307). Here each belief is sharpened at t (the belief in a stock flow p) and tq (q) in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7}, a 3 by 3 grid, three seeds each, beside round 29's net2 on its own beliefs (net2-v7) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7), on the validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and among 2 and 4 copies. Rule, stated before the results: for each of net2-r33hn and net2-v7hpn the winner is the (t, tq) with the highest three-seed mean of the five-family mean and the copies-30s score, each weighted one half; it replaces (0.5, 0.5) only if it beats it by more than 0.02 (the seed spread of 307) and no seed loses to (0.5, 0.5) on that score. The winners then run once on the test links.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); G="$IN/n/traffic_head.pt"; echo "8ad397a52a7f09fc2b2a136f017d0a52b49a5f0bfcae9f10040d8a015891f2e8  $G" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-s$s.onnx"); r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s$s"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s$s"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cp "$G" "$e/traffic_head.pt"; for t in 3 5 7; do for q in 3 5 7; do a="t${t}q${q}-s$s"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-r33hn-$a" "$e" --t "0.$t" --tq "0.$q" --traffic "$G"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hpn-$a" "$d" --t "0.$t" --tq "0.$q" --traffic "$G" --traffic-p; for b in r33hn v7hpn; do P+=(--policy "net2-$b-$a=$OUT/p/net2-$b-$a.onnx"); done; done; done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 116 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
